# Code of Conduct

This project is part of rOpenSci and follows the
[rOpenSci Code of Conduct](https://ropensci.org/code-of-conduct/).

The rOpenSci Code of Conduct applies to all people participating in rOpenSci
community spaces, including package repositories, issue trackers, pull requests,
online forums, events and other project communication channels.

Please read the Code of Conduct before contributing. By participating in this
project, you agree to abide by its terms.
